messages:
lina: Heads-up — planning a small kernel hotpatch on runtime tonight 22:30 PT. Touches KV-cache alignment + a quant kernel fix. Target fleet: s-rt-prod-1 (20 slots). Need slot claims, canary owners, rollback ready. Will keep batching off for canary.

raj: I can own the rollout window and slot assignment. @sam can you be primary rollback owner?

sam: On it. I'll be on-call from 22:15 PT. What's the minimal smoke checklist?

maria: I'll run the perf + correctness smoke on canary. Propose canary=2 slots, disable_batching=true, model=redwood-3b-quant. If p50 latency > 40ms or error_rate > 0.5% -> rollback.

lina: Agreed. Canary config:
```
model: redwood-3b-quant
slots: 2
disable_batching: true
timeout: 30s
```

Also we'll do prefix KV cache warmup prior to canary (sample 5 requests each model).

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Scheduled hotpatch for s-rt-prod-1 at 2026-03-17T22:30:00Z by @lina. Canary slots: 2. Notified: @raj @maria @sam.

raj: Slot claim steps:
```
claim-slot s-rt-prod-1 --owner=raj --reason="hotpatch kernel fix"
``` 
Smoke command to run from eng-net:
```
smoke-check --target http://<canary-ip>:8080 --script smoke/runtime_smoke.py --samples 200
```

I'll post the canary IPs 15m before.

sam: Rollback artifact prepared: `rollback-to sha:abc123` (holds the pre-hotpatch runtime build). I'll stage the rollback job and keep it paused until manual trigger.

andy: I can approve the image after canary passes. I'll be watching tracing + SLO dashboard. :eyes: 

maria: Quick note: disable autoscaler for the canary node pool to avoid extra slots during tests.

lina: Good catch. Step list for tonight:
1) 22:10 PT - Claim slots (raj)
2) 22:15 PT - KV warmup (maria)
3) 22:20 PT - Post canary IPs (raj)
4) 22:30 PT - Apply hotpatch to canary (lina)
5) 22:35–22:45 PT - Observe; if pass -> stagger rollout; if fail -> rollback (sam)

If anyone can't make window pls +1 here or DM.

andy: +1 available

raj: slot claims will be done at 22:10 PT. I'll ping here when done.

maria: Will run smoke and post results as short summary (p50/p95/error_rate)

sam: Rollback job ready and tested. I'll trigger if thresholds breach.

lina: Thanks team :thumbsup: I'll kick off and keep updates in this thread. If canary passes by 22:50 PT we proceed to staggered rollout; otherwise we abort and investigate.
